Airtel Africa plc
(‘Airtel Africa’, or the ‘Company’)
Transaction in Own Shares
London and Lagos, 11 August 2026: Airtel Africa announces that in the
period 03 August 2026 to 07 August 2026 it purchased the following number
of its ordinary shares of USD 0.50 each from Barclays Capital Securities
Limited (“Barclays”) pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as
part of its share buyback programme, details of which were announced on 22
May 2026.

About Airtel Africa
Airtel Africa is a leading provider of telecommunications and mobile money
services, with operations in 14 countries in sub-Saharan Africa. Airtel Africa
provides an integrated offer to its subscribers, including mobile voice and data
services as well as mobile money services both nationally and internationally.
The company’s strategy is focused on providing a great customer experience
across the entire footprint, enabling our corporate purpose of transforming
lives across Africa.
